Sources and caveats
Plants: EIA-860M (September 2026), public domain.
Lines: HIFLD Electric Power Transmission Lines (last edited Sep 2023), public domain. Lines built since 2023 may be missing.
Substations: inferred by clustering line endpoints; names only where 2+ lines agree.
Data centers: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); many facilities are unmapped.
Area labels are approximate context, not facility locations.
